mapper.select: select day_task_id, task_date, task_type, title, detail, status, owner, ref_code, started_time, finished_time from erp_day_task where task_date = #{taskDate} order by started_time asc, day_task_id asc

select id, business_type, business_id, action, to_status, opinion, operator_name, date_format(operate_time, '%H:%i') as operateTime, date_format(operate_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as operateAt from erp_approval_record where operate_time >= #{start} and operate_time < date_add(#{end}, interval 1 day) order by operate_time asc
